text: Vietnam promotes economic, trade, and investment cooperation with Mexico and Peru

In separate meetings with the Presidents of Mexico and Peru on the sidelines of the APEC 2026 Leaders' Week, General Secretary and President To Lam proposed enhancing cooperation in economics, trade, investment, and science and technology, while requested support from both countries for Vietnam to successfully host APEC 2027.

On November 18 morning, in Shenzhen, China, General Secretary and President To Lam of Vietnam held separate bilateral meetings with Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum and Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori on the sideline of the 33rd APEC Leaders' Week hosted by China, according to the Vietnam News Agency.

During the meeting with Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum, General Secretary and President To Lam congratulated Mexico on its socio-economic and foreign development achievements, as well as its successful hosting of the 2026 World Cup.

Expressing delight at the positive developments in bilateral relations after 51 years of diplomatic ties (1975 - 2026), the General Secretary and President affirmed that Vietnam always values its relationship with traditional friends in Latin America, including Mexico, one of Vietnam's largest trading partners in the Western Hemisphere.

The General Secretary and President proposed that both sides enhance cooperation in politics, economics, trade, investment, culture, education, tourism, and traditional medicine; and strengthen coordination within the framework of APEC and the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP).

Particularly, the General Secretary and President suggested both sides increase exchanges and resolve economic-trade issues related to Vietnam's steel and shrimp products; affirming Vietnam's readiness to consider opening its market to Mexican agricultural products.

The General Secretary and President also requested Mexico's support for Vietnam to successfully host APEC 2027; and extended an invitation to President Claudia Sheinbaum to visit Vietnam and attend the APEC 2027 Leaders' Week in Phu Quoc.

President Claudia Sheinbaum appreciated Vietnam's development achievements and its growing international stature; expressing a desire to promote multifaceted cooperation, viewing Vietnam as an important bridge for Mexico to enhance cooperation with ASEAN.

The Mexican President proposed expanding cooperation in balanced trade, science and technology, digital transformation, innovation, artificial intelligence (AI), sustainable development, circular economy, education, training, and healthcare.

Both leaders agreed to strengthen coordination and support each other at the United Nations, APEC, the Forum for East Asia-Latin America Cooperation (FEALAC), and CPTPP; jointly supporting multilateralism, contributing to maintaining regional and global peace and stability.
President Claudia Sheinbaum extended an invitation to General Secretary and President To Lam for a state visit to Mexico.
The General Secretary and President gladly accepted the invitation at a suitable time.

In the meeting with Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori, both leaders expressed joy over the positive developments in the friendship and cooperation between Vietnam and Peru after 32 years of diplomatic relations (1994 - 2026).

Affirming Peru as a close friend and important partner of Vietnam in Latin America, General Secretary and President To Lam proposed that both countries enhance substantive cooperation in economics, trade, investment, science and technology, innovation, and digital transformation.

The General Secretary and President suggested Peru continue to facilitate Vietnamese enterprises investing and doing business in the country, including Viettel Group; and support Vietnam in successfully hosting APEC 2027.
President Keiko Fujimori expressed a desire to expand cooperation with Vietnam, especially in digital economy, agricultural trade, energy, and mineral exploitation.

Emphasizing that both Vietnam and Peru are highly open economies, the Peruvian President welcomed Vietnamese businesses to increase investment in Peru, particularly in the digital economy and trade sectors.

Both leaders agreed to continue close coordination and mutual support at multilateral forums, especially the United Nations, CPTPP, and APEC; promoting cooperation between ASEAN and the Latin American region.
General Secretary and President To Lam extended an invitation to President Keiko Fujimori to visit Vietnam and attend the APEC 2027 Leaders' Week in Phu Quoc.
The Peruvian President also invited General Secretary and President To Lam for a state visit to Peru.
The General Secretary and President thanked and gladly accepted the invitation at a suitable time.
